Tengmo Väder uses your location only to show weather for where you are. It is never sent anywhere except the weather services that answer your request.
Keep this widget on your location

To keep a \"My location\" widget showing weather for wherever you are, even when the app is closed, Android needs \"Allow all the time\" location access. This is only used to refresh that widget — never sent anywhere except the weather services, and never used for anything else.
Background location was not granted. The widget will keep showing your last known location until you allow it.
No weather saved yet. Connect to the internet to load it.

This app has no account and no backend server of ours. Your favorite places, last-viewed location, widget choices and display preferences (theme, units, language) are saved only on this device and are never sent anywhere.

Your location is used only to show weather for where you are. Its coordinates are sent solely to the public weather and place-name services that answer your request (SMHI, Open-Meteo, MET Norway, OpenStreetMap Nominatim), never to us. \"My location\" widgets can keep following your position while the app is closed if you allow background location; it is used for nothing else.
The app contains no advertising, no analytics and no tracking identifiers.
Weather observations, forecasts, warnings and UV data: SMHI open data (Sweden\'s national weather service).
Worldwide weather data and place search: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com).
Forecast data: MET Norway (api.met.no), licensed CC BY 4.0.
Map tiles and place names: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
Temperature and wind map layers: OpenWeatherMap (openweathermap.org).
